hero_lead: Sara answers every shopper in seconds, day and night, in English and Roman Urdu. She knows your styles, sizes and prices, and she turns "price?" into a confirmed order.

pain_story: Phone on the pillow. "Size 42 hai?" at 12:40 AM. "Price?" on a post that already shows the price. "COD hai?" for the fifth time today. Reply in the morning and the buyer has already ordered from the store that answered first.
pain_closer: You didn't start a store to type the same answer fifty times a day.

inbox.text: Price? Delivery Lahore mein kitne din?
COD hai? Parcel khol ke dekh sakte hain?

icp_headline: Three kinds of buyers message you every day.
icp_lead: Each one asks different questions before they buy. Sara answers each the way they need.

icps.title: The groom's family buying formal shoes
icps.pain: They need the right size and style before a fixed date, and they ask late at night after the family decides.
icps.fix: Asks the event and budget, suggests formal pairs in their size, and sends the link to order.
icps.question: Shaadi ke liye formal shoes chahiye, budget 4000 tak. Size 42.

icps.title: The man on his feet all day
icps.pain: He wants comfort, not fashion, and needs to know which pair will last before he pays.
icps.fix: Asks how he spends his day and recommends comfortable pairs with sizes in stock.
icps.question: Office mein poora din khare rehna hota hai, comfortable shoes kaunse hain?

icps.title: The shopper who found you through an ad
icps.pain: He has never bought from you, so he asks about COD, delivery time and whether he can check the parcel.
icps.fix: Answers delivery and payment questions from your own rules, then guides him to order.
icps.question: Cash on delivery hai? Parcel khol ke dekh sakte hain?

does.title: Knows your shelf.
does.text: Answers from your real products, prices and sizes. It never offers what you don't have.

does.title: Helps them choose.
does.text: It asks a question or two, formal or casual, what budget, and suggests what fits.

does.title: Adds the right extra.
does.text: It suggests socks with sneakers or a belt with formal shoes. You set how pushy it is.

does.title: Sends a link to buy.
does.text: One checkout link. Payment happens on your own store checkout.

does.title: Answers order questions.
does.text: Delivery, COD and exchange questions answered from your own rules.

does.title: Hands you the hard ones.
does.text: Exchanges, refunds and complaints come to your team with the details already collected.

faq.q: My customers want a real person.
faq.a: They want an answer. When they need a person, it hands them to your team with the details ready.
Yes. It replies in the language the customer types in.

faq.q: What if it says something wrong?
faq.a: It answers only from your store and your rules, and anything it isn't sure about goes to you.

close_headline: Tonight, let Sara take the 1 AM questions.
close_lead: Share your delivery charges, COD and exchange rules. We load them, connect your website and DMs, and you watch the first night's conversations in the morning.
